commands.command:
set -eu
tmpfile=$(mktemp /etc/.cron.allow.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -f "$tmpfile"' EXIT HUP INT TERM

restorecon /etc/cron.allow
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM

commands.command:
set -eu
cleanup() {
  crontab -r 2>/dev/null || true
  crontab -u opsadmin -r 2>/dev/null || true
  crontab -u nobody -r 2>/dev/null || true
}
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM
entry='17 3 31 2 * /bin/true # infraset-access-test'
printf '%s\n' "$entry" | crontab -
printf '%s\n' 'ROOT_INSTALL=allowed'
crontab -l
runuser -u opsadmin -- sh -c 'printf "%s\n" "17 3 31 2 * /bin/true # infraset-access-test" | crontab -'
printf '%s\n' 'OPSADMIN_INSTALL=allowed'
runuser -u opsadmin -- crontab -l
set +e
denied_output=$(runuser -u nobody -- sh -c 'printf "%s\n" "17 3 31 2 * /bin/true # infraset-access-test" | crontab -' 2>&1)
denied_rc=$?
set -e
printf 'NOBODY_INSTALL_RC=%s\n%s\n' "$denied_rc" "$denied_output"
[ "$denied_rc" -ne 0 ]
cleanup
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
printf '%s\n' '--- POST-TEST SPOOL ---'
find /var/spool/cron -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%f %m %u:%g\n' | sort
printf '%s\n' 'ACCESS_TESTS_CLEANED=YES'
